title: gesture
content_html:
gesture

In gesture in grey and hand life, a mark can suggest the speed, pressure or hesitation of the movement that made it. The gestures by which people communicate care or refusal are open to interpretation too. How much of a movement’s character is available to somebody who sees it once, sees it repeated or meets it only in a drawing? Gesture in grey 1 · Hand life 1

Reading note. Daoism. Cook Ding in the Zhuangzi works by following the spaces in what he cuts. The story also shows him slowing down at a difficult place. A drawn line may carry comparable changes of pace. Where did the maker have to accommodate the material, and where did long practice let the movement proceed easily? Zhuangzi, 3
